failed_command_scope: Parse 13 Campaign154-related JSON records, then hash final artifacts and read wall-clock time in one zsh command
root_cause: The zsh loop variable was named path. In zsh, path is the tied array for PATH, so the loop overwrote command search directories before the later shasum and date invocations.

repair_boundary.safe_repair: Use a non-special loop variable and absolute /usr/bin/shasum and /bin/date paths.
